normalizations.equation: u_t = -u_xxx + 6 u u_x, x in R/Z, t in R
normalizations.physical_spaces: Real distributions, mean zero. Viewed as 2-periodic; e_k(x)=exp(i*k*pi*x); normalized sesquilinear distribution/test pairing extends (1/2) integral_0^2 f conjugate(g). Odd Fourier coefficients vanish for 1-periodic distributions.
normalizations.weights: <k> = 1 + |k|; norm sup_k <k>^s |q_k|. Birkhoff output weights use n, whereas potential coefficients vanish at odd k; do not silently identify coefficient q_(2n) with q_n.
normalizations.reality: z_0 = 0 and z_(-n) = conjugate(z_n), n>=1; I_n = z_n*z_(-n).
normalizations.solution: Unique H^-1 limit of smooth-data KdV solutions, for every smooth approximating sequence converging in H^-1, pointwise in time; imported existence and uniform-on-compact-time continuity must be supplied.
normalizations.weak_star: sigma(FL_0^(s,infinity), FL_0^(-s,1)); coordinate version sigma(ell_0^(s,infinity), ell_0^(-s,1)). Actual predual topology, not full-dual weak topology.
normalizations.trajectory_topology: Continuous maps on [-T,T] into the weak-star space, with compact-open/uniform-on-compact topology; pointwise-in-time dependence alone is insufficient.
normalizations.library_pairing: Original distribution reality is equality with native physical conjugation on all smooth tests. Physical period one is equivalent to zero odd modes in the period-two normalized coefficients. The complex coefficient/original Wiener weak dual homeomorphism and equality with the full original real mean-zero period-one Wiener test topology on bounded source subsets are now proved. The action on real Wiener tests is real valued.

main_statements.quantifiers: For every -1/2<s<=0; one restriction of the original H^-1 Birkhoff map; every norm-bounded V; every q in endpoint space.
conclusions: Phi: FL_0^(s,infinity) -> ell_0^(s+1/2,infinity) is bijective, bounded and real analytic.
Phi|V: V -> Phi(V) is a weak-star homeomorphism for every norm-bounded V.
Iso(q), defined inside real mean-zero H^-1 via the full periodic spectrum, lies in and is norm-bounded in FL_0^(s,infinity); weak-star homeomorphism on Iso(q).
main_statements.source_correction: Printed first codomain is ell_0^(s,infinity). Correct to s+1/2, as given immediately before the theorem, in its own weak-star pairing, and in Lemma 3.3. Visually confirmed PDF p.3. No refutation is being pursued.

main_statements.quantifiers: For every integer N>=0, restriction of the same original Phi.
conclusions: Phi^(N,1): real mean-zero FL^(N,1) -> ell_0^(N+1/2,1) is a global real analytic diffeomorphism and gives global Birkhoff coordinates.

main_statements.quantifiers: For every integer N>=0 and every T>0.
conclusions: The global KdV solution map FL_0^(N,1) -> C([-T,T],FL_0^(N,1)) is real analytic in the norm Banach spaces.
